The group (the Company together with NU Vista Limited and Vadraj Cement Limited) operates 13 cement plants comprising five integrated units, seven grinding units and one clinkerization unit, alongside 58 RMX plants, serving 22 states nationally with no international operations and nil exports. risks.note: Flagged in the BRSR materiality table as both risk and opportunity: climate change presents physical, regulatory, technological and market-transition risks, with financial implications stated as both positive and negative. Mitigated through energy efficiency, renewable sourcing and enhanced use of biomass fuels such as agro-waste.

Water availability, climate variability and increasing regulatory expectations require efficient water management and long-term water resilience - material for a cement/RMX operation. Mitigated by zero liquid discharge via STPs at all sites, 5R water stewardship and rainwater harvesting infrastructure.

Stated as critical for operational continuity and regulatory compliance, with financial implications flagged as negative. Plant shutdowns and project execution phases are identified as critical high-risk periods requiring special safety mobilisation; mitigation is a Zero Harm approach, safety audits, Health Passport medical tracking and AI-enabled unsafe-act detection.

Managing SOx, NOx and dust is essential for environmental compliance; financial implications flagged as negative. Mitigated by fuel-mix optimisation with biomass and domestic coal, WHRS adoption, and continuous monitoring of pollution-control equipment, with emission limits stated to be maintained below regulatory thresholds.

Operations may impact ecosystems and habitats; conservation plans are stated as operational at all mining locations, with site-specific reforestation and native tree plantation - relevant to continued limestone mining access and long-term resource security.
risks.risk: Biodiversity impact of mining and manufacturing operations

risks.note: Business Ethics & Compliances is flagged as a risk with negative financial implications, managed through the Code of Conduct, whistleblower/vigil mechanisms, internal and external audits and Audit Committee oversight. Separately, Data Security & Privacy is flagged as a risk in an increasingly digital environment, mitigated by Zero Trust architecture, MFA, PAM/SoD, frequent audits, VAPT cycles, log monitoring and network segmentation.
risks.risk: Business ethics, compliance and data security
